سَحَّاجٌ A camel that pares the surface of the ground with his foot, (S, * K, * TA,) so that he is not slow in becoming attenuated and abraded in the sole. (TA.) ―
-b2- Also (assumed tropical:) A man who makes oaths to follow one another with little, or no, interruption: (TA:) and so ↓ مِسْحَاجٌ and ↓ سَحُوجٌ applied to a woman. (K, * TA.) And حَلِفٌ سَحَّاجٌ (assumed tropical:) A swearing in which the oaths are made so to follow one another. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
